prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: FIVE progression forms of one friendly rune fox companion, a carefully aligned character development sheet.
Input image 1 is the SELECTED CANONICAL FOX. Preserve this exact new friendly face, eye size, soft round muzzle, kind tiny open smile, relaxed arched eyebrows, amber eyes, head proportions, left-facing three-quarter pose, lifted near forepaw, all limb placements, body skeleton and one upward curled tail. This is the children's beloved rescued friend, not an enemy.
Primary request: five increasingly magical coats of THIS SAME individual. All FIVE remain equally friendly and cute. Progress changes large fur shapes, cream color blocks, and broad cyan rune ornaments, not expression, age, body anatomy or camera. Same body scale and ground baseline in every cell. Higher stages must be obviously distinguishable when shrunk to 128px.
READ ORDER left to right top row forms 1/2/3, bottom row forms 4/5/EMPTY.
1. Closest to canonical: warm orange coat, simple cream chest and cheek tufts, cream tip on one plush tail, a small cyan forehead diamond and one broad cyan shoulder curl. REDUCE tiny scattered runes. Friendly smile as reference.
2. A slightly fuller cream chest ruff, small cream ankle socks, tail has one unmistakably broad CYAN band with a slim gold edge below cream tip; retain orange body and friendly face.
3. Fuller scalloped cream chest ruff and cream socks to knees, upper HALF of the single curled tail is creamy ivory with a large cyan spiral; broad cyan side flourish. Clear silhouette and color step from form2, no new anatomy.
4. Soft double-layer cream shoulder/chest ruff spreading toward upper back, richer swept cheek tufts, broad cream foreleg cuffs, tail becomes a much more plush feather-shaped single curled tail with warm ivory upper TWO THIRDS and large readable cyan crescent/rune inset; orange lower tail, flank and face remain. Small warm-gold edging on existing cyan markings only.
5. A striking yet gentle final companion: expansive layered cream fur collar flowing naturally into shoulder tufts, same smiling orange face, same four paws and skeleton. Luxuriously fluffy SINGLE curled tail, upper two thirds ivory with a very large cyan whorl bordered in warm gold, separated orange lower section; a broad cyan-gold shoulder wave and cream paws. DISTINCTIVE large shape/color changes, not a cloud of little lines or a glow-only difference. No armor, crown, horns, wings, extra tails, floating accessories or extra limbs.
Composition: precisely 3 columns x 2 rows, equal SQUARE cells, panoramic 3:2 sheet (ideally 3072x2048). Top row has three foxes. Bottom row has two foxes and an entirely empty transparent third cell. Each full fox centered with same feet baseline at 83 percent cell height and same head placement; every fur tip and tail stays inside 12 percent margins on all sides. Never crop any body part. Do not draw a row divider or cell borders.
Style: polished hand-painted premium 2D fantasy game sprite; dimensional painted fur, crisp dark linework, clean broad color masses readable on a dark-blue game background; no red/yellow matte fringe. Preserve selected face, scale, lighting and style across forms.
Transparent background, genuine alpha. No floor, shadow, scenery, checkerboard, UI, frame, lettering, numbers or watermarks. Children cannot rely on reading; evolution must read through picture alone. Source art will be split on equal cell boundaries, one shared crop and scale to identical transparent 512px canvases. No independent per-form trimming or scaling. Runtime UI text and controls remain separate layers. This is static concept art, NOT an animation.
